nodes.label: Creative North Star: O Sinal Contido
nodes.rationale: A contained green signal on a cold white field; authority through rarity and restraint.
nodes.norm_label: creative north star: o sinal contido

nodes.label: Esmeralda Cortante #10B981
nodes.rationale: The single accent color, used sparingly (<=10% visible surface) for CTAs, logo dot, hovers and glows.

nodes.label: Verde Floresta Profundo #065F46
nodes.rationale: Active/press state of the accent and dark warm depth for gradients.

nodes.label: Grafite #1F2937
nodes.rationale: Body ink and dark section base (footer, dark pauses).

nodes.label: Branco Frio #FFFFFF
nodes.rationale: Default cold white base.

nodes.label: Inter typeface
nodes.rationale: Single grotesque family used in four weights; no pairing.

nodes.label: Flat at rest, shadow on state
nodes.rationale: Surfaces are flat at rest; shadows only respond to state (hover, scroll, focus).
nodes.norm_label: flat at rest, shadow on state

nodes.label: Motion serves content
nodes.rationale: Animation reveals, guides or gives tactile feedback; never decorates or distracts.

nodes.label: Conversion goal: qualified opportunities via WhatsApp/email
nodes.norm_label: conversion goal: qualified opportunities via whatsapp/email

nodes.label: Anti-references: generic SaaS, cream, over-animated, dense
nodes.norm_label: anti-references: generic saas, cream, over-animated, dense

nodes.label: The site is the proof
nodes.rationale: Every section demonstrates the craft the studio sells; no shortcuts.

nodes.label: Confidence via restraint
nodes.rationale: Authority comes from precision and breathing room, not volume of stats/badges.

nodes.label: Show, do not list
nodes.rationale: Prefer real artifacts (portfolio projects) to generic bullet points.

nodes.label: Direct and honest
nodes.rationale: Plain Portuguese copy without jargon or empty superlatives.

nodes.label: IMG Kippo barbearia .png
nodes.rationale: Screenshot or mockup of a premium barbershop website (Lion Barber Club) stored as an image asset in the favcon folder of the Kippo Barbearia project, likely used as a visual reference or inspiration piece.

nodes.label: Hero section layout
nodes.rationale: Large hero area combining product photography, headline, and call-to-action to immediately communicate premium barbershop positioning.

nodes.label: Navigation menu
nodes.rationale: Horizontal top navigation with sections Sobre, Serviços, Equipe, Galeria, Depoimentos, FAQ, Contato and an Agendar button.

nodes.label: Dark luxury aesthetic
nodes.rationale: Black background with gold accents, serif typography, and high-end product photography conveying a premium, traditional barbershop identity.

nodes.label: Geometric Rounded Typography
nodes.rationale: Stylized letterforms use rounded, geometric strokes with circular negative-space cutouts, suggesting a modern, approachable visual language for the KIPPO brand.

nodes.label: Monochrome Color Scheme
nodes.rationale: White glyphs on a solid black background maximize contrast and readability at favicon sizes while keeping the brand mark versatile across contexts.

nodes.label: Circular Dot Motif
nodes.rationale: Repeated circular holes/dots embedded in the letterforms act as a unifying visual motif across the logo, reinforcing a crafted or precision-oriented brand impression.

nodes.label: Kippo Odonto Website Screenshot
nodes.rationale: Hero-section screenshot of a premium dental clinic landing page. Design intent: convey high-end dental care through a clean clinical photo background, elegant serif headline with a gold accent word, and a conversion-focused navigation with an always-visible booking button.

nodes.label: Kippo Odonto
nodes.rationale: Brand/clinic concept represented by the landing page: a Sao Paulo-based high-standard dental practice.

nodes.label: Hero Section
nodes.rationale: Full-viewport hero section combining a background clinical-office photograph, headline, subtext, and call-to-action buttons.

nodes.label: A arte de criar sorrisos que duram uma vida
nodes.rationale: Main headline emphasizing longevity and artistry of dental care; the word sorrisos is styled in gold to highlight the emotional outcome.
nodes.norm_label: a arte de criar sorrisos que duram uma vida

nodes.label: Odontologia de alto padrao value proposition
nodes.rationale: Subheadline explaining the clinic combines technology, aesthetics, and human care to transform health and confidence.
nodes.norm_label: odontologia de alto padrao value proposition

nodes.label: Top Navigation Menu
nodes.rationale: Horizontal navigation containing RESULTADOS, PROCEDIMENTOS, EQUIPE, DEPOIMENTOS, and AGENDAR links.

nodes.label: Agendar Agora Button
nodes.rationale: Primary conversion button in the top-right navigation, present on every page to maximize appointment bookings.

nodes.label: Agendar Avaliacao Button
nodes.rationale: Secondary hero CTA inviting users to book an evaluation.

nodes.label: Conheca os Procedimentos Link
nodes.rationale: Alternative hero path for users who want to browse services before booking.

nodes.label: Role Scroll Indicator
nodes.rationale: Bottom-centered prompt indicating the page continues below the fold.

nodes.label: Landing page screenshot (Lion Barber Club; file named kippo-barbearia.png)
nodes.rationale: PNG screenshot stored in the React public asset folder. Visual content prominently displays the brand 'Lion Barber Club' and a premium barbershop landing-page layout, while the file name references 'Kippo Barbearia'. Likely a reference/mockup or misnamed asset, not a favicon despite the 'favcon' directory name.
nodes.norm_label: landing page screenshot (lion barber club; file named kippo-barbearia.png)

nodes.label: Hero Section Layout
nodes.rationale: Full-width hero with left product photography and right headline/subhead/CTA block, demonstrating a premium service landing page pattern.

nodes.label: Premium Barbershop Positioning
nodes.rationale: Copy and visual treatment (dark palette, gold accents, 'Barbearia Premium — São Paulo', 'Est. 2014' badge) signal an upscale, traditional-yet-modern barbershop brand identity.

nodes.label: KIPPO favicon PNG
nodes.rationale: Brand favicon for the KIPPO website, providing visual recognition in browser tabs and bookmarks via a high-contrast black-and-white mark.

nodes.label: KIPPO logo
nodes.rationale: Primary brand mark rendered as a geometric wordmark; letters share rounded terminals and a circular dot motif for visual cohesion.

nodes.label: High-End Dental Clinic Positioning
nodes.rationale: The clinic positions itself as a São Paulo-based high-standard dentistry practice, combining technology, aesthetics, and human care to transform health and confidence.

nodes.label: Value Proposition: Lifelong Smiles
nodes.rationale: Headline 'A arte de criar sorrisos que duram uma vida' frames the service as an aesthetic, durable outcome rather than a transactional procedure.

nodes.label: Dark Gradient Overlay on Clinical Photo
nodes.rationale: A dark blue gradient overlay over the bright clinical photo increases text contrast and reinforces a premium, calming brand mood while keeping the environment visible as credibility proof.
nodes.norm_label: dark gradient overlay on clinical photo

nodes.norm_label: green and orange gym color scheme
